players.product: GEM 63 / GEM 63XL solid rocket boosters for the Atlas V and Vulcan launch vehicles

quarterly_data.signal: CFO John Greene: Q3 2026 sales were $11.1 billion, up 7% year-over-year with higher sales at all four segments; segment operating income grew 5% at a 12.1% margin rate (the prior year benefited from a favorable $68 million EAC adjustment at MS); EPS increased to $7.89, up 3%; capital expenditures were $306 million; adjusted free cash flow was $1.8 billion, up over 40%, helped by working capital and $371 million of proceeds from the sale of a test asset on the B-21 program. Segments: Aeronautics sales up 14% (F-35 production and sustainment, B-21 ramp, B-2 sustainment) at a 10.5% margin; Defense Systems sales $2.3 billion, up 12% (Sentinel ramp, tactical solid rocket motor programs), operating income $250 million at 10.8%; Mission Systems sales up 2% (restricted airborne radar, marine systems) at 15.8%; Space sales up 2% (national security programs including restricted efforts and GPI, partly offset by commercial resupply timing) at 11.3%.
quarterly_data.figure: Q3 sales $11.1 billion (+7%); segment margin 12.1%; EPS $7.89 (+3%); adjusted free cash flow $1.8 billion

quarterly_data.signal: CEO Kathy Warden / CFO John Greene: backlog increased 20% to a record $110 billion on bookings of over $16 billion, a book-to-bill of 1.5 for the quarter and 1.45 year to date; key awards included $4.6 billion on restricted programs, an additional $2 billion on Sentinel and three additional E-2D production aircraft for $1 billion, plus multiple competitive restricted space wins. Northrop definitized the Virginia-class Block VI submarine procurement for an additional 12 shipsets of main propulsion units and ship service turbine generators, adding $1.4 billion to backlog and supporting its partnership with the Navy through 2032. CEO: about 35% of backlog is expected to burn down over the next 12 months and another 55% over the following 24 months.
quarterly_data.figure: backlog $110 billion (+20%); bookings over $16 billion; book-to-bill 1.5 (1.45 YTD); Virginia-class $1.4 billion

quarterly_data.signal: CFO John Greene: 2026 sales guidance stays at $43.75 billion-$44.25 billion with a full-year book-to-bill of at least 1.3; segment operating income guidance raised $65 million at the midpoint to $4.94 billion-$5.04 billion (approximately 11.3% margin), EPS guidance up $0.70, adjusted free cash flow kept at $3.1 billion-$3.5 billion; AS operating margin raised to high 9% and MS to mid 15%, implying a Q4 segment margin of mid to high 11%. 2027: sales growth between 5% and 7% with higher sales in all four segments, 10 to 20 basis points of margin expansion beyond the 2026 midpoint, capex at 4.5% of sales or approximately $2.1 billion to build B-21 capacity, and adjusted free cash flow of $3.3 billion-$3.7 billion; Q4 2026 capex approaching $1 billion. CEO: the 2028 growth rate is expected to be higher than 2027's, with further acceleration possible.
quarterly_data.figure: 2026 segment OI $4.94 billion-$5.04 billion (~11.3%); EPS +$0.70; 2027 sales growth 5%-7%; 2027 capex approximately $2.1 billion; 2027 adjusted FCF $3.3 billion-$3.7 billion

quarterly_data.signal: CFO John Greene: Space Systems margins improved to 11.3% 'including stable performance on GEM 63XL', and 'We resumed delivery of rocket motors in the third quarter.'
quarterly_data.figure: Space margin 11.3%; rocket motor deliveries resumed in Q3

quarterly_data.signal: CEO Kathy Warden: Northrop recently launched and deployed its first 21 satellites for the Space Development Agency's Tranche 1 Transport Layer and expects nearly 50 of its 150 satellites to be deployed in the next six months for transport and tracking missions; on Sentinel it completed the first full vertical assembly of an inert missile at Vandenberg Space Force Base and gained U.S. Air Force approval of design maturity for first flight to proceed in 2027 (Sentinel sales have been growing modestly above the company pace).
quarterly_data.figure: 21 satellites launched; nearly 50 of 150 in the next six months; Sentinel first flight 2027

quarterly_data.signal: CEO Kathy Warden: in the last three months Northrop opened or expanded facilities in Utah, Maryland, Arizona and Florida, adding over 1 million sq ft of manufacturing and engineering space and more than 2,000 new jobs, supporting accelerated B-21 production, solid rocket motor and hypersonic propulsion capacity, space systems and aircraft manufacturing; B-21 acceleration capacity takes effect after the facilitization, largely through 2028. CFO: the B-21 loss burn-down typically runs about $100 million a quarter ($70 million this quarter).
quarterly_data.figure: over 1 million sq ft; more than 2,000 jobs; B-21 loss burn-down about $100 million a quarter

quarterly_data.signal: CEO Kathy Warden on munitions: Northrop has approximately $1 billion of work in this area today and is entering agreements to become a component provider - solid rocket motors, fuses, warheads and nozzles - including on Munitions Acceleration Council weapons where it has not been a key provider; 2027 will be a ramping year on those contracts toward minimum guaranteed quantities. It introduced Raid Hunter, a gun-based counter-UAS air defense system combining Bushmaster chain gun technology with new precision-guided 50-millimeter ammunition, with clear demand signals from key allies; Northrop's goal is to double international sales by 2031.
quarterly_data.figure: approximately $1 billion of munitions component work; 50-millimeter ammunition

quarterly_data.signal: CEO Kathy Warden on microelectronics and quantum: Northrop introduced FORTITUDE, a chip the size of a grain of rice that it says delivers up to three times the power and 20x the signal quality of comparable solutions, for radar, GPS, electronic warfare and future 6G, for defense and commercial uses. Its Reciprocal Quantum Logic (RQL) ultra-efficient superconducting chip technology underpins its quantum computing work, and Northrop is evaluating strategic alternatives for this foundry business - investing alone, broadening the investment base or separating it - with details in the coming months; CFO: no quantum investment dollars are included in the outlook.
quarterly_data.figure: up to three times the power; 20x the signal quality

quarterly_data.signal: CEO Kathy Warden on autonomy: Talon Blue, designed and built in 24 months, completed its first fully autonomous flight (taxi, takeoff, maneuvers and landing); its Talon IQ control system has demonstrated interoperability with other companies' autonomy software, with about half a dozen companies doing cooperative integration in its test bed; Northrop has over 500,000 flight hours of unmanned systems experience. About 2/3 of its space portfolio is national security space.
quarterly_data.figure: 24 months; about half a dozen companies; over 500,000 flight hours
